item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 10/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, it will be mainly fine and hot during the day over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. With the weakening of the anticyclone aloft, there will be a few showers over southern China midweek next week.
